name: Bankworth
title: The Grand Bank (re-formed)
//: Story Phase 16 (chapter 194): THE GRAND STENCHMASTER'S GRAND BANK AND GRAND TRUST, re-formed out of the Grand Dispensary's takings as a gentleman: vast, polite, gold-trimmed, in a crown that is plainly a small vault door. Stands beside the counter for the rest of the phase. Never takes the captain's gold.

name: Lord Puffchester
title: Lord Nicotinius Puffchester the Third
//: Story Phase 16 (chapters 203-205): Lord Nicotinius Puffchester the Third, the Bureau of Ceremonial Ignition's first applicant: an ancient gentleman who wants his cigarette lit by the ancient formal procedure, with a 97-page application. Waits at the counter window; convinced, in the end, by a cheap lighter. The cigarette is never described, never lit on screen.

name: Lady Rancidella
title: Grand Credit Applicant
//: Story Phase 16 (chapter 196): Lady Rancidella, whose sash has been in the family since the Morning of Many Winds. Scores 998. Redeems her whole welcome bonus at the converter at once.

name: Earl Wheezeworth
title: Customer
//: Story Phase 16: Earl Wheezeworth, a spectral customer at the counter (the Grand Dispensary, the Grand Bank, the Bureau): out of the haze at the end of the barricade, served, and gone.
